description: POST /v1/paymaster/deny-rules - upserts the (chainId, kind, address) rule. Re-posting the same triple replaces the label; omitting it clears the stored one. The address is stored lower-cased. Deny rules are checked before the contract allowlist and win, so this blocks sponsorship for that sender, or for every op with that address as any call target (a whole batch included), immediately. Confirm with user.

kind.description: sender = the smart account submitting the op; target = any call target of the op (for a delegated transfer, the inner ERC-20 token); one match refuses the whole batch.

name: paymaster_deny_rules_add
title: Add a paymaster deny rule
